note: Body proportion master (pipeline/blender/spike_pipeline/modeling/body_master.py). A character's body = skeleton proportions (character.json 'proportions', consumed by spike_specs.apply_proportions) + volume multipliers (character.json 'body_shape'). 1.0 is the reference body: a realistic athletic 1.66 m woman. Change relationships between segments, never a uniform scale. Ranges are what the validator accepts; values outside them read as distorted anatomy.

head_units.desc: Height / head height (head incl. hair volume). Lower = bigger head.

leg_ratio.desc: Leg length: hip-joint height / height. Raising it lengthens thigh and shin (the ankle and foot keep their height) and shortens the torso, so the character reads taller without being taller.

head_scale.desc: Modeled head size (1.0 = reference anime head, 0.167 m chin to crown). Judge with head_units: the head-to-body relationship, not the head alone.

neck_length.desc: Neck length vs reference; sets the neck base, and with leg_ratio the torso length.

arm_length.desc: Arm chain length (upper arm and forearm together, balanced).

torso_width.desc: Rib cage, upper chest and back width.

torso_depth.desc: Rib cage and upper chest depth (side profile).

bust.desc: Chest volume (follow the design art: slender does not mean flat).

waist_width.desc: Waist width. Stylize, do not exaggerate into an hourglass.

wrist.desc: Wrist; should stay clearly narrower than the forearm.

ankle.desc: Ankle; should narrow visibly below the calf.

depth.desc: Skull depth behind the face (the back of the head).

cranium.desc: Eye line to crown: vault height.

face_length.desc: Eye line to chin: lower face length.

cheek.desc: Midface cheek volume under the eyes, beside the nose.

jaw_round.desc: Jaw contour: below 1 sharper / more V-shaped, above 1 softer / rounder.

nose.desc: Nose size and projection (bridge, tip, wings).

silhouette_checks.note: Measured by pipeline/tools/silhouette_compare.py on orthographic renders; ratios are widths at the landmark divided by the head width.
